output.reason: I find the brief convincing because of two things it found: yield fell only in the award tiers that were cut, and early-action yield fell as much as regular-decision yield even though early-action decisions went out on time on the old system. Both point to the scholarship change rather than the portal, and the next steps are clear. I'm holding back some confidence because the delayed decisions also hit those same merit-reviewed tiers, the brief doesn't say where the segment figures came from, and it hasn't yet checked what students who turned down their places actually said.
